text:
jamie (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: comp, leveling, and calibration. i'll keep this short  drop questions here and i'll bundle answers + action items.
emike (Eng): deadline question  when do managers need to submit final comp decisions? we've got a few folks finishing goals this sprint.
sara (Manager): add: what qualifies for a calibration exception? can managers nominate outside the band?
emily (People Ops): TL;DR answers: comp decisions due by 2024-08-15 (end of cycle week). retro pay will be applied on the first payroll after changes are processed; payroll will publish exact pay dates. managers may request calibration exceptions with written rationale; exceptions reviewed by calibration panel (manager + ppl ops + peer director). internal process link: https://intranet.redwood/comp-calibration
jamie (People Ops): manager checklist: 1) submit comp form per direct report, 2) attach 2-3 evidence bullets for promo cases, 3) cc your director if requesting an exception. reminder emails will go out 2w before deadline.
sara (Manager): for evidence bullets  is peer feedback required or optional?
emily (People Ops): peer feedback optional but recommended for promotions. minimally include cross-functional impact + measurable outcomes.
mike (Eng): what about offers already extended? if bands shift, do we have to reissue?
amy (CTO): offers made before the comp effective date stand as approved. if you'd like to revisit because bands moved materially, reach out to hiring + ppl ops for an expedited review.
people_ops_bot: Reminder: Calibration packet generator is live. Run `/calibration packet create` in #people-ops-tooling to generate your team's packet. :robot_face:
jamie (People Ops): appeals: there's a 10-business-day clarification window with manager after decisions are communicated. formal appeals escalate manager -> director -> ppl ops.
emike (Eng): edge case: contractor -> perm conversion mid-cycle. do they follow the same timeline?
emily (People Ops): conversions follow the same review cadence; note conversion on comp form so payroll/benefits team can set the correct effective date.
sara (Manager): can we get a promotion evidence template to standardize submissions?
emily (People Ops): yes, template uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/promo-evidence-template.docx. use 3-bullet structure (impact, metrics, endorsements).
jamie (People Ops): scheduling manager office hours next Wed 3pm PT to walk through packet generation + exceptions. RSVP: https://cal.com/peoples-ops/office-hours. i'll publish consolidated FAQ + action items by EOD tomorrow and tag folks.
amy (CTO): thanks for the clear follow-up, appreciate it. :clap:
jamie (People Ops): closing here  DM or ping in channel if anything urgent and i'll add it to the doc. :thumbsup:
